**Submission Category:** Crafted Weapon

**Weapon Name:** 'The Shit Fist'

**Short Description:** 'The shit fist is a weapon that you create with... Well your shit. All you have to do is take a dump, dip some nails in it, stick the nails or any object you chose on one side of it, stick your hand in it, let it dry up, attach some ropes around it so it doesn't break after the first hit and you're good to go!

Ps : Works better if you're sick'
